snippets.title: Create and activate virtual environment
snippets.desc: Creates a local .venv folder and activates it (macOS/Linux).

snippets.title: Install from requirements.txt
snippets.desc: Installs all packages listed in requirements.txt into the active environment.

snippets.title: Freeze dependencies
snippets.desc: Writes currently installed packages and versions to requirements.txt.

snippets.title: Upgrade pip
snippets.desc: Upgrades pip inside the active virtual environment.

snippets.title: Run tests with pytest
snippets.desc: Runs the test suite with verbose output using pytest.

snippets.title: Deactivate virtual environment
snippets.desc: Exits the active virtual environment and returns to the system Python.

snippets.title: Create venv (Windows)
snippets.desc: Creates and activates a virtual environment on Windows (PowerShell/CMD).
